items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The RGB->YUV420/NV12 path is one function well over 100 lines. The 18-argument `emitChromaRow(...)` call is pasted three times, differing only in ring indices. `.zig-cache` and the `zig-out/.so` build output are committed to the workspace.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Many unexplained magic constants: 16828, 270, 6416, 65, 540928, `pair_stride = halfW + 32`. Strides are cast with `@intCast(src_stride[0])`, so a negative stride is undefined behaviour. Fallback paths do return false instead of silently swallowing errors.
